note: F1: a plentiful grass layer (lib/foliage.ts). 'enabled' true = grass; anything else = no grass and everything exactly as before (one data edit and a deploy). Grass is walk-through, has no collider and has its own budget, apart from the 260/140 caps: at most 'grassPerChunk' in a chunk and 'grassWorld' in the World (set grassWorld to 0 to remove only the grass). 'density' is bundles per 100 square metres per region, before the caps (this slice: Meadow only); 'minGap' keeps two bundles apart in metres. First guesses to tune by eye. F2: 'blooms' is a separate switch for small flower clumps (Meadow and Paper Downs), with its own seed and caps (bloomsPerChunk, bloomsWorld; 0 removes only the blooms); the same rules as the grass. 'palette' is the petal colours, baked into the clumps (no per-instance colour).
